description.value: The Nanaimo Ice Centre is a City of Nanaimo-operated indoor arena primarily dedicated to ice hockey and skating. As a municipal recreation facility it serves local leagues and public skate sessions. Touring cyclists in Nanaimo may find it a potential rest stop, though it is not a cycling-specific attraction.
